Runtime view for KB auditors: each task's agent-visible context is its frozen_time, its user_scenario (the persona, i.e. what the customer can say), the published docs (KB_search/grep through db_query.py) and the agent-side share tools (db_query.py). Per-task runtime files: <difficulty>/<idx>.runtime.json (frozen_time + user_scenario only). Do not read tasks/*/tasks/*.json until your blind audit is frozen.
